# EKS cluster: checked source configuration

This Space keeps the checked eks cluster configuration used by the EKS inference example. It is the unchanged starting point for later environments.

Start here when you open this Space in Hub. This page explains the problem this example is meant to show, what to inspect, why it matters, and where the evidence lives.

## Why this example exists

This component defines the EKS control plane, IAM roles, add-ons, and first system node group.

The source stays separate from environment settings, so a reviewer can see exactly what ConfigHub changes later.

## What this example shows

- The exact public source is `oci://ghcr.io/confighub/configs/eks-inference/eks-cluster@sha256:cc6ae42f8347d5e06d7ad787f5582d96a3005c55674cc52c8c2a2d849917899f`.
- 4 ConfigHub Units hold the Kubernetes configuration for this component.
- The source already contains literal Kubernetes YAML, so no renderer runs for this component. No separate lifecycle route is recorded for this component.
- This component belongs in the management cluster. It is step 3 for that part of the installation.
